name: Encrypted Parchment
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, adventurer.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the rogue trainer Rwag. He would have words with you when you're ready.
narrative.objectives: Read the Encrypted Parchment and speak to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.
narrative.offerRewardText: Now that you know where I'm holding up, I should let you know: the Shattered Hand's asked me to look out for you. They want me to train you and keep you informed of anything they might need. Even if you're not interested in helping them yet--which you'd be a fool not to be--I'll do what I can to train you... for a small fee. Come back to me anytime you think you're ready, and we'll see what you're ready to learn.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Shhh, not so loud. I don't trust Nartok over there. Anyone that has to hide deeper in a cave than I do shouldn't be trifled with.

I trust you had no problem finding your way around?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 1 to 2, 290 XP in all.

quests.name: The New Horde
quests.objectiveText: Report to Gornek in the Den.

quests.name: Your Place in the World
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.name: Cutting Teeth
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

quests.name: Encrypted Parchment
quests.objectiveText: Read the Encrypted Parchment and speak to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.
